shortDescription: GIMS Noida Staff Nurse Online Form 2026 for 100 posts. Apply online from 10/08/2026 to 30/09/2026.
content:
Government Institute of Medical Sciences (GIMS), Greater Noida has invited online applications for 100 Staff Nurse posts. Eligible candidates can apply online from 10/08/2026 to 30/09/2026.

Eligibility

  • B.Sc Nursing or Post B.Sc Nursing Degree, or GNM / Diploma in Nursing with 2 years of experience.
  • Age limit: 21 to 40 years as on 01/07/2026. Age relaxation applies as per the recruitment rules.

Application fee

General / OBC / EWS candidates: Rs. 1,298/-; SC / ST / PH candidates: Rs. 944/-, including GST. Pay through online or offline fee mode only.

How to apply

  1. Open the official application link.
  2. Read the notification and complete the application form.
  3. Upload the required documents and pay the fee.
  4. Preview, submit and print the final form.
